beats.title: Dinner, delegated
beats.caption: Find the best masala dosa near BKC under 6 USDT by 8 pm.
beats.voiceover: We ask for the best masala dosa near BKC, under 6 USDT, by 8 pm.

beats.title: Four agents, one errand
beats.caption: Concierge, scout, analyst and payer split the work.
beats.voiceover: We give each agent a named role, so we can see who searches, checks and pays.

beats.title: Cheap is not enough
beats.caption: Tawa Tangle costs less. Its 18.4% refund rate rules it out.
beats.voiceover: We compare the synthetic payment histories and reject Tawa Tangle. A lower price does not outweigh its higher refund rate.

beats.title: Check before paying
beats.caption: Confirm the shop’s payout address, spending cap and active status.
beats.voiceover: We check the shop’s ENS records before paying: its payout address, spending cap and status.

beats.title: One signature, paid
beats.caption: Pay Filter & Fold 4.80 test USDT, with no gas for the agent.
beats.voiceover: We sign once and pay Filter & Fold 4.80 test USDT. The agent pays no gas.

beats.title: Keep the payment history
beats.caption: Payment records become graph data for the next decision.
beats.voiceover: We keep payments in a graph, so the next choice can use earlier orders and refunds.

beats.title: Spill, refund, another coffee
beats.caption: Upload the spill photo, refund 0.80, then reorder coffee for 0.80.
beats.voiceover: We upload the spilled-coffee photo, receive a 0.80 test USDT refund, then order another coffee for 0.80.

beats.title: The pass says no
beats.caption: Dosas for everyone exceed the daily pass. Payment refused.
beats.voiceover: We ask for dosas for everyone at the hackathon. The request exceeds the daily pass, so we refuse payment.

beats.title: You keep control
beats.caption: Pause and resume the payer. Shut down the spare agent permanently.
beats.voiceover: We pause the payer, resume it when needed, and shut down a spare agent for good.

beats.title: Sunday breakfast, again
beats.caption: Two idlis, one medu vada and one coffee renew weekly for 2.40.
beats.voiceover: We renew the Sunday breakfast box every week for 2.40 test USDT: two idlis, one medu vada and one filter coffee.

beats.title: Count the reads
beats.caption: 2 reads against about 48. A read comparison, not a speed claim.
beats.voiceover: We compare reads for this demo query: 2 reads against about 48. We are counting reads, not measuring speed.

beats.title: Same kit, cab ride
beats.caption: Pay a fixed-fare cab ride with the same SDK.
beats.voiceover: We use the same SDK to pay for a fixed-fare cab ride. The checkout changes; the payment kit stays the same.

beats.title: Checkout in 17 lines
beats.caption: A shop adds checkout in 17 lines of code.
beats.voiceover: We show a shop adding checkout in 17 lines of code.
